{"subject":"Pinecrest claims file demo: recap and what's coming","body":"Hi Owen and Lily,

Thanks for making time today, and sorry again for the screen-share hiccup.

What we showed: your claims file, partitioned by state, loaded into the sandbox with the default setup. Ingest ran in about six minutes. We also showed claims by line of business by week, with a state filter and links down to the underlying rows.

Still open:
- Paid amount and allowed amount came in as text. Owen, please confirm whether they should be numbers.
- Twelve rows failed the date format check. Lily, thanks for offering to send your list so Priya can compare it against ours.

Priya will send the twelve failed rows and a short note on the two text columns today.

Owen, I'll reach out about finding a time to finish the demo. Does the summary view match what you had in mind?

Best,
Nate","customer_value_line":"not stated","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U009","excerpt":"Ingest ran in about six minutes."},{"utterance_id":"U013","excerpt":"Twelve rows failed the date format check, they're in this table."},{"utterance_id":"U011","excerpt":"A couple of columns came in as text that I think should be numbers, the paid amount and the allowed amount."},{"utterance_id":"U016","excerpt":"I can send it."},{"utterance_id":"U030","excerpt":"Priya will send the failed rows and a short note on the two text columns, so Owen has something to look at when he's back."},{"utterance_id":"U031","excerpt":"Yes, I'll send that today."}]}
